name: Maria Waldrast
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Maria Waldrast in Matrei am Brenner**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps, **Matrei am Brenner** invites you to experience authentic mountain charm and timeless hospitality. At **Maria Waldrast**, a cozy alpine retreat, you’ll find warmth, tradition, and breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks.

Indulge in hearty **Tiroler** cuisine—think crispy **Kaiserschmarrn**, savory **Käsespätzle**, and tender **Schweinsbraten**—all crafted with local ingredients. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the **Ötztal** or **Zillertal** valleys, unwind in our rustic yet refined rooms, where every detail reflects the region’s heritage.

Whether you’re seeking adventure, relaxation, or a taste of **Tirol’s** culinary delights, **Maria Waldrast** promises an unforgettable escape in one of Europe’s most stunning landscapes. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this hidden gem awaits your visit.
